answer: Here an account is a promise of future work. The ledger tests that promise each epoch with a new atlas and a jury of peers. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest karst a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. So a horizon of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 1tebd.
